label: 22. FYI: All three of us have just changed our pro…

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: FYI: All three of us have just changed our profile pics!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh yeah,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I didn't notice until you pointed it out.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I was bored, so I scrolled back through our chats,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: just to see what we've been talking about

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: and then I noticed it.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Looks like everyone picked their best shots, huh?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Still,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'd say mine came out on top.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Of course I am.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anyone with eyes can tell mine's the best-looking one here.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Anyone with eyes can tell

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: mine looks the best.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Lol,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I didn't know you had a knack for comedy, Anis.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That might be the funniest thing

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I've ever heard.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Maybe you should try being a comedy pop star,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: instead of a combat one.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Enough, both of you.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Why are you even arguing about this?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: The answer's obvious.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: My pic's the best.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: No matter how hard they try,

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: ducks can't turn into swans.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Aren't swans supposed to be really vicious?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Say whatever you want.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: It doesn't change the fact that mine's the best.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: This isn't getting us anywhere.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: We're not gonna sort this out ourselves.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Let's just ask the Commander.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: If it's Master, I trust his judgment.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Mine's obviously the best!

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: No, the Commander will choose me.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: No wayyyy!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: There's no way he's picking anyone's but mine!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Commaaanderrrr!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I know you're watching, so hurry up and answer already!
My phone kept going off for a while,
so I was wondering what was up.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: This is too important to drag out.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Even if we pull an all-nighter, we're ending this tonight.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Go on, pick one, Master.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Mine's the best, right?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: I have no doubt the Commander will choose mine.
They all look good though...
Do I really have to pick?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I was kinda hoping you'd say something else,

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: but yeah, that's so you, Commander.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: it'd probably be better to go ask him in person.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Oh, I like that.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: We'll just stay in the Commander's Room

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: till he picks one.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: You're in too, right, Rapi?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Looks like Rapi already took off.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I just heard someone tearing down the hallway.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Did Anis leave too?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: There it goes again.
You seem pretty relaxed about all this, Neon.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Composure comes from confidence, after all.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'll make my way over at my own pace,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: so wait in your room, Master.
